# Shiny App-Packages

Shiny App-Packages (or `sap`) provides the code examples in for the
[Shiny App-Packages](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/shiny-app-pkgs/) book.
You can install the `pkgdown` branch of the `sap` package using
`remotes`:

``` r

install.packages('remotes')
remotes::install_github('mjfrigaard/sap', ref = '22_pkgdown')
```

The [`22_pkgdown`](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/sap/tree/22_pkgdown)
branch demonstrates how to create a package website using `pkgdown` and
GitHub Actions.

## Movie review data application

The original code and data for the Shiny app comes from the [Building
Web Applications with
Shiny](https://rstudio-education.github.io/shiny-course/) course.

Launch the application using;

``` r

library(sap)
launch_app()
```

## Learn more

The [Developing & Testing Your Shiny
Application](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/dev-test-shiny/) workshop was
provided at R in Pharma (2023).

# Package index

## Modules

Application modules

- [`mod_aes_input_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_aes_input_server.md)
  : Aesthetics Input Module - Server
- [`mod_aes_input_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_aes_input_ui.md)
  : Aesthetics Input Module - UI
- [`mod_scatter_display_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_scatter_display_server.md)
  : Scatter Plot Display Module - Server
- [`mod_scatter_display_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_scatter_display_ui.md)
  : Scatter Plot Display Module - UI
- [`mod_var_input_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_var_input_server.md)
  : Variable Input Module - Server
- [`mod_var_input_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/mod_var_input_ui.md)
  : Variable Input Module - UI

## Apps

Launch apps

- [`launch_app()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/launch_app.md)
  : Launch the Movies Review Application
- [`movies_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/movies_ui.md)
  : User Interface for the Movies Review Application
- [`movies_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/movies_server.md)
  : Handles the server-side logic for the Movies Review application.

## Utilities

Utility functions

- [`display_type()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/display_type.md)
  : Shiny app display mode helper
- [`scatter_plot()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/scatter_plot.md)
  : Create scatter plot
- [`text_logo()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/text_logo.md)
  : Create a Text-based Logo in HTML

## Logging

Logging functions

- [`log_message()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/log_message.md)
  : Log Application Behaviors
- [`logr_msg()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/logr_msg.md)
  : Log Messages to Console and File with Optional JSON Format

## Data

App data

- [`movies`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sap/reference/movies.md) :
  IMDB movies data
